settings.confidence_auto_hint_html: At or above this score the LLM/source winner is silently saved as identified. Below it lands in Needs Review with top-3 candidates. Default 95%.
settings.confidence_floor_hint_html: Below this floor the match is marked Failed (not surfaced in the NR modal). Default 50%.
settings.general_language_hint: The app re-renders translations after you reload the page.
settings.audio_sync_hint_html:
The server picks one of two pipelines per file (hardware re-encode vs stream-copy). Each has its own audio-vs-video latency profile that a single offset can't tune for both. Drag a slider while a matching codec is playing in another tab — close and reopen the player for the new value to take effect.

Positive delays audio (use when audio feels ahead of picture). Negative pulls audio forward.
settings.llm_provider_opt_embedded: embedded (built-in llama.cpp — downloads a local model)
settings.embedded_custom_hint_html: Only public *.gguf files on huggingface.co. Repo must look like Owner/Name.
settings.llm_docs_title: How to use the LLM — all options
settings.llm_docs_li_cpu_html: Embedded — CPU (easiest): Provider = embedded, pick a model (e.g. Qwen2.5 1.5B), click Download model. Runs inside the Animarr container, no GPU needed. Best for models up to ~3B.
settings.llm_docs_li_gpu_html: Embedded — GPU (Vulkan): set ANIMARR_LLM_VULKAN=1 in the compose environment:, add --device /dev/dri and group_add: [video] (AMD/Intel), then restart. Vulkan is installed on first boot and layers are offloaded; it falls back to CPU automatically if the GPU isn't usable.
settings.llm_docs_li_compatible_html: Remote — compatible (Ollama / LM Studio): run your own server (see deploy/ollama/), Provider = compatible, Base URL = http://ollama:11434, Model = the tag you pulled. Nothing is downloaded into Animarr.
settings.llm_docs_li_openai_html: Remote — OpenAI: Provider = openai, paste an API key, Model = e.g. gpt-4o-mini.
settings.llm_docs_footer_html: Embedded models are stored on the data volume (/app/data/models) and survive restarts. A bigger model = more accurate identification but more RAM/time — match it to your hardware.
settings.meta_sources_intro: Identification asks each enabled source for candidates, then the LLM picks the best match. Toggle a source off to mute it without erasing the saved key.
settings.meta_mal_key_placeholder: Client ID from MAL API portal
settings.meta_language_intro: Language for titles, overviews and genres fetched from TMDb (and localized posters when available). Changing it re-fetches every identified title; fields with no translation fall back to English. Anime matched only on MyAnimeList stay in English.

settings.skip_intro_intro: Detect opening/ending timestamps so the player shows a Skip button and surfaces "next episode" at the credits start. Sources are tried cheapest-first and the first hit wins.
